metadata.description: Complete BYKICodes OBD2 Diagnostic Database - 4565 Code Master Collection (Enhanced Malaysian Vehicle Support + Cross-Batch Compatibility + Proton Saga Codes)
metadata.malaysian_enhancement: Critical U1xxx network codes added for Proton/Malaysian vehicles

body.description: Body systems including airbags, doors, windows

chassis.description: Chassis systems including ABS, steering, suspension

warning.description: Service soon - may affect performance or emissions

codes.official_description: Fuel Volume Regulator Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Faulty fuel volume regulator, damaged wiring, or open circuit.
codes.user_explanation: ECU can't control the pump properly - fuel flow erratic.

codes.official_description: Fuel Volume Regulator Control Circuit Range/Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Sticking regulator, weak fuel pump, or sensor drift.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel pressure off-spec, may feel sluggish or stall.

codes.official_description: Fuel Volume Regulator Control Circuit Low
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Short to ground, failing regulator driver.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel command signal too weak; lean running possible.

codes.official_description: Fuel Volume Regulator Control Circuit High
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Short to +12V, internal FVR failure.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel pump commanded max; rich smoke, high fuel use.

codes.official_description: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in fuel shutoff valve control, damaged wiring.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel shutoff system not responding - safety concern.

codes.official_description: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit Low
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Short to ground in fuel shutoff valve circuit.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel shutoff valve stuck - engine may not shut off properly.

codes.official_description: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit High
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Short to power in fuel shutoff valve circuit.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel shutoff valve circuit shorted - safety system compromised.

codes.official_description: Engine Position System Performance Bank 1
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Camshaft position correlation error, timing chain stretch.
codes.user_explanation: Engine timing is off - can cause severe damage if driven.

codes.official_description: Engine Position System Performance Bank 2
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Bank 2 camshaft correlation error, timing component failure.
codes.user_explanation: Bank 2 timing is off - engine damage possible if driven.

codes.official_description: Intake Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: OCV/solenoid jammed, oil sludge, broken wiring.
codes.user_explanation: Variable valve timing stuck - rough idle, flat power.

codes.official_description: Intake Camshaft Timing Over-Advanced (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Over-retarded cam gear, dirty oil, OCV stuck open.
codes.user_explanation: Cam timing too far forward - rattle, poor pick-up.

codes.official_description: Intake Camshaft Timing Over-Retarded (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: OCV stuck closed, low oil pressure.
codes.user_explanation: Opposite of P0011 - lazy acceleration, CEL.

codes.official_description: Exhaust Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Exhaust OCV fault, damaged harness.
codes.user_explanation: ECU lost control of exhaust cam phaser.

codes.official_description: Exhaust Camshaft Timing Over-Advanced (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Phaser stuck, thin oil, timing chain stretch.
codes.user_explanation: Noticeable ping, rough warm idle.

codes.official_description: Exhaust Camshaft Timing Over-Retarded (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Exhaust cam timing delayed, OCV stuck closed.
codes.user_explanation: Poor exhaust valve timing - reduced power and efficiency.

codes.official_description: Crankshaft/Camshaft Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor A)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Stretched timing chain/belt, slipped tooth, bad sensor.
codes.user_explanation: Engine timing out of sync - urgent to fix.

codes.official_description: Crankshaft/Camshaft Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor B)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Bank 1 exhaust cam correlation error, timing component failure.
codes.user_explanation: Bank 1 exhaust cam timing is wrong - engine damage risk.

codes.official_description: Crankshaft/Camshaft Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor A)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Bank 2 intake cam correlation error, timing system fault.
codes.user_explanation: Bank 2 intake timing is wrong - stop driving immediately.

codes.official_description: Crankshaft/Camshaft Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor B)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Bank 2 exhaust cam correlation error, timing failure.
codes.user_explanation: Bank 2 exhaust timing is wrong - engine damage possible.

codes.official_description: Intake Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 2)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Bank 2 intake OCV circuit fault, wiring damage.
codes.user_explanation: Bank 2 variable valve timing not working - poor performance.

codes.official_description: Mass Air Flow Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Contaminated or failed MAF sensor, air leak.
codes.user_explanation: Airflow reading nonsense - poor fuel economy.

codes.official_description: Mass Air Flow Range/Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Same as P0100 but sensor drift rather than open/short.
codes.user_explanation: ECU sees airflow doesn't match RPM - check intake leaks.

codes.official_description: Mass Air Flow Low Input
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Signal voltage too low - dirty sensor or wiring short.
codes.user_explanation: Car may run rich, lack power.

codes.official_description: Mass Air Flow High Input
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Voltage too high - sensor wet/oiled, open circuit.
codes.user_explanation: May stall right after start.

codes.official_description: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 High
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit or unplugged sensor.
codes.user_explanation: ECU thinks intake air freezing cold - overfuels.

codes.official_description: Engine Coolant Temperature Low Input
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Bad coolant temp sensor, short to ground.
codes.user_explanation: Fan runs full, high idle, heavy fuel use.

codes.official_description: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor A Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Potentiometer wear, wiring fault.
codes.user_explanation: Throttle response erratic, limp mode.

codes.official_description: Coolant Thermostat (Coolant Temp Below Regulating Temp)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Thermostat stuck open, low coolant, sensor error.
codes.user_explanation: Engine runs too cool - high fuel, low heater.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Circuit (Bank 1-Sensor 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: A/F sensor worn, heater open, wiring burn.
codes.user_explanation: Front O2 dead - ECU reverts to safe map.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Slow Response (B1-S1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Sensor ageing, exhaust leak upstream.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel trim slow - slight surge.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Low Voltage (B1-S2)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Rear O2 tired, wiring corroded.
codes.user_explanation: Catalyst monitoring fails - may still drive fine.

codes.official_description: O2 Heater Circuit (B1-S2)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Heater element open circuit.
codes.user_explanation: Sensor slow to warm - fails emission test.

codes.official_description: System Too Lean (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Vacuum leak, weak fuel pump, dirty injector.
codes.user_explanation: Idle hunts, CEL, maybe misfire.

codes.official_description: System Too Rich (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Leaky injector, high fuel pressure, MAF error.
codes.user_explanation: Black exhaust smoke, fuel smell.

codes.official_description: Random/Multiple Misfire
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Ignition coil, plug, injector, compression issues.
codes.user_explanation: Engine shakes - stop heavy driving.

codes.official_description: Cylinder 1 Misfire
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Plug, coil, injector on #1.
codes.user_explanation: Single-cylinder stumble.

codes.official_description: Cylinder 2 Misfire
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Same as P0301 but cylinder 2.
codes.user_explanation: As above.

codes.official_description: Cylinder 3 Misfire
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Same as P0301 but cylinder 3.
codes.user_explanation: As above.

codes.official_description: Cylinder 4 Misfire
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Same as P0301 but cylinder 4.
codes.user_explanation: As above.

codes.official_description: Knock Sensor 1 Circuit (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Sensor cracked, connector soaked in oil.
codes.user_explanation: ECU pulls timing - power loss.

codes.official_description: EGR Flow Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Carboned EGR valve, clogged port.
codes.user_explanation: Rough idle, ping on accel.

codes.official_description: EGR Flow Insufficient
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Valve not opening, vacuum leak, blocked passages.
codes.user_explanation: NOx emissions high, CEL.

codes.official_description: Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Worn cat, rich mixture, O2 drift.
codes.user_explanation: Catalytic converter losing efficiency.

codes.official_description: Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Same as P0420 but other bank.
codes.user_explanation: Catalytic converter (Right/Bank 2) weak.

codes.official_description: EVAP System
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Loose fuel cap, vent valve stuck.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel vapour leak detected.

codes.official_description: EVAP Small Leak
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Cracked hose, bad cap seal.
codes.user_explanation: Tiny vapour leak - minor.

codes.official_description: EVAP Vent Control Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Vent solenoid rusted, wiring fault.
codes.user_explanation: Tank can't purge vapours correctly.

codes.official_description: EVAP Gross Leak / No Flow
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Cap off, hose off, canister cracked.
codes.user_explanation: 'Check fuel cap' warning.

codes.official_description: Vehicle Speed Sensor
codes.workshop_diagnosis: VSS failure, broken reluctor ring.
codes.user_explanation: Speedometer drops to zero intermittently.

codes.official_description: Idle Control System
codes.workshop_diagnosis: IAC valve sticky, air leak, ECU fault.
codes.user_explanation: Fluctuating or high idle.

codes.official_description: Immobilizer Key Incorrect
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Key transponder not recognised.
codes.user_explanation: Car cranks, won't start.

codes.official_description: Serial Communication Link
codes.workshop_diagnosis: CAN wiring short, loose ground.
codes.user_explanation: Multiple modules offline.

codes.official_description: PCM Processor Fault
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Internal ECU error.
codes.user_explanation: Replace/flash ECU ASAP.

codes.official_description: Transmission Control System (MIL Request)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: TCM stored its own codes; gateway sets this.
codes.user_explanation: Gearbox fault flagged - need scanner.

codes.official_description: Input/Turbine Speed Sensor Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Sensor open, wiring, metal debris.
codes.user_explanation: Erratic shift, limp mode.

codes.official_description: Output Speed Sensor Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Sensor failure, wiring damage.
codes.user_explanation: No speed data to TCM - harsh shifts.

codes.official_description: Incorrect Gear Ratio
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Slipping clutch pack, low ATF, valve body issue.
codes.user_explanation: Gearbox can't hold correct ratios - urgent.

codes.official_description: Torque Converter Clutch (TCC) Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: TCC solenoid fault, fluid pressure low.
codes.user_explanation: Shudder at cruise, high revs.

codes.official_description: Shift Solenoid A
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Solenoid jam, burnt connector.
codes.user_explanation: Hard shift / no 1-2 shift.

codes.official_description: Shift Solenoid D Performance/Stuck Off
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Stuck valve body or solenoid.
codes.user_explanation: Fails to engage 3-4 gear.

codes.official_description: Pressure Control Solenoid 'C' Performance/Stuck Off
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Line-pressure solenoid weak.
codes.user_explanation: Harsh/shuddering shifts.

codes.official_description: System Voltage Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Weak alternator, corroded battery cables.
codes.user_explanation: Electrical gremlins, dim lights.

codes.official_description: System Voltage Low
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Alternator output low under load.
codes.user_explanation: Battery light, stalling at idle.

codes.official_description: Generator Control Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ECU-regulated alternator fault.
codes.user_explanation: Charge light, limp mode.

codes.official_description: Malfunction Indicator (MIL) Control Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: LED blown, wiring to cluster open.
codes.user_explanation: CEL won't light at KOEO - fail inspection.

codes.official_description: Transmission Range Sensor 'PRNDL' Input
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Range switch mis-aligned, corroded.
codes.user_explanation: Gear display wrong, no reverse lights.

codes.official_description: MAF Sensor Out of Self-Test Range
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Dirty MAF, intake duct leak.
codes.user_explanation: Sudden drop in power.

codes.official_description: Igniter Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Toyota-generic but often logged as generic.
codes.user_explanation: Ignition driver fault - misfire.

codes.official_description: EVAP Leak (Fuel Tank Area) - Honda/Universal
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Loose cap or tank/discharge hose leak.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel smell, CEL.

codes.official_description: Startability Malfunction (Toyota)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ECU measures long crank time.
codes.user_explanation: Hard starting especially cold.

codes.official_description: Battery Disconnected (Chrysler generic)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Battery cable removed recently.
codes.user_explanation: No repair needed unless recurring.

codes.official_description: Throttle Actuator Control Range/Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Electronic throttle body carboned, motor weak.
codes.user_explanation: Failsafe mode, limited RPM.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Signal Stuck Lean (B1-S1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Vacuum leak or O2 pegged lean.
codes.user_explanation: Idle surge, lean burn.

codes.official_description: ECM/PCM Internal Engine Off Timer Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ECU memory capacitor faulty.
codes.user_explanation: Random idle relearn resets.

codes.official_description: Driver Airbag Deployment Control Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Driver airbag squib circuit fault, wiring damage.
codes.user_explanation: Driver airbag may not deploy in crash - urgent safety issue.

codes.official_description: Passenger Airbag Deployment Control Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Passenger airbag squib circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Passenger airbag may not deploy - safety critical.

codes.official_description: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: LF wheel speed sensor fault, wiring damage.
codes.user_explanation: ABS and stability control disabled - braking affected.

codes.official_description: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: RF wheel speed sensor fault, wiring damage.
codes.user_explanation: ABS and stability control disabled - braking affected.

codes.official_description: Lost Communication with ECM/PCM
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Engine control module communication lost.
codes.user_explanation: Engine computer not responding - multiple systems affected.

codes.official_description: Lost Communication with TCM
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Transmission control module communication lost.
codes.user_explanation: Transmission computer not responding - shifting affected.

codes.official_description: Throttle Position Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Problem
codes.workshop_diagnosis: TPS signal outside expected range during operation.
codes.user_explanation: Throttle sensor reading wrong - engine may idle poorly or stall.

codes.official_description: Throttle Position Sensor Circuit Low Input
codes.workshop_diagnosis: TPS signal voltage below minimum threshold.
codes.user_explanation: Throttle sensor voltage too low - engine may not respond to acceleration.

codes.official_description: Throttle Position Sensor Circuit High Input
codes.workshop_diagnosis: TPS signal voltage above maximum threshold.
codes.user_explanation: Throttle sensor voltage too high - engine may run rough or have poor idle.

codes.official_description: Throttle Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent
codes.workshop_diagnosis: TPS signal is intermittent or erratic.
codes.user_explanation: Throttle sensor signal cutting in and out - unstable engine performance.

codes.official_description: Insufficient Coolant Temperature for Closed Loop Fuel Control
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Engine not reaching operating temperature fast enough.
codes.user_explanation: Engine taking too long to warm up - fuel economy may be poor.

codes.official_description: Insufficient Coolant Temperature for Stable Operation
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Engine coolant temperature too low for normal operation.
codes.user_explanation: Engine running too cold - heating may be poor and fuel economy reduced.

codes.official_description: Intake Air Temperature Too High
codes.workshop_diagnosis: IAT sensor reading temperature above threshold.
codes.user_explanation: Air entering engine is too hot - performance may be reduced.

codes.official_description: Barometric Pressure Too Low
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Atmospheric pressure sensor reading below minimum.
codes.user_explanation: Air pressure sensor showing wrong reading - fuel mixture may be incorrect.

codes.official_description: Injector Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: General fuel injector circuit problem detected.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel injector system problem - engine may run rough or not start.

codes.official_description: Passenger Airbag Circuit Short to Ground
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Passenger airbag circuit has short to ground.
codes.user_explanation: Passenger airbag electrical problem - airbag may not deploy in crash.

codes.official_description: Left Front Turn Signal Circuit Short to Ground
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Left front turn signal has electrical short.
codes.user_explanation: Left front turn signal not working - driving safety affected.

codes.official_description: Driver Door Ajar Switch Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Driver door position sensor not working properly.
codes.user_explanation: Car thinks driver door is open when closed - interior light may stay on.

codes.official_description: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Left front ABS wheel speed sensor circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Left front wheel speed sensor problem - ABS may not work properly.

codes.official_description: Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Right front ABS wheel speed sensor circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Right front wheel speed sensor problem - ABS may not work properly.

codes.official_description: Left Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Left rear ABS wheel speed sensor circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Left rear wheel speed sensor problem - ABS may not work properly.

codes.official_description: Right Rear Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Right rear ABS wheel speed sensor circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Right rear wheel speed sensor problem - ABS may not work properly.

codes.official_description: Power Steering Pressure Sensor Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Power steering pressure sensor circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Power steering sensor problem - steering assistance may be reduced.

codes.official_description: Lost Communication with Transfer Case Control Module
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Transfer case control module not responding.
codes.user_explanation: 4WD system computer not communicating - 4WD may not work.

codes.official_description: Lost Communication with Gear Shift Module
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Gear shift control module communication lost.
codes.user_explanation: Gear shift computer not responding - transmission shifting affected.

codes.official_description: Lost Communication with Cruise Control Module
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Cruise control module not communicating.
codes.user_explanation: Cruise control computer not responding - cruise control won't work.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Front oxygen sensor voltage too low.
codes.user_explanation: Front oxygen sensor reading low - engine may run rich, poor fuel economy.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Front oxygen sensor voltage too high.
codes.user_explanation: Front oxygen sensor reading high - engine may run lean, rough idle.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity Detected (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Front oxygen sensor showing no activity.
codes.user_explanation: Front oxygen sensor not working - engine running in backup mode.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Front oxygen sensor heater not working.
codes.user_explanation: Oxygen sensor heater failed - sensor won't work properly when cold.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Rear oxygen sensor circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Rear oxygen sensor not working - emissions control affected.

codes.official_description: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity Detected (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Rear oxygen sensor showing no activity.
codes.user_explanation: Rear oxygen sensor not responding - catalytic converter monitoring disabled.

codes.official_description: Injector Circuit Malfunction - Cylinder 1
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Cylinder 1 fuel injector circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Cylinder 1 fuel injector problem - engine will misfire and run rough.

codes.official_description: Injector Circuit Malfunction - Cylinder 2
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Cylinder 2 fuel injector circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Cylinder 2 fuel injector problem - engine will misfire and run rough.

codes.official_description: Injector Circuit Malfunction - Cylinder 3
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Cylinder 3 fuel injector circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Cylinder 3 fuel injector problem - engine will misfire and run rough.

codes.official_description: Injector Circuit Malfunction - Cylinder 4
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Cylinder 4 fuel injector circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: Cylinder 4 fuel injector problem - engine will misfire and run rough.

codes.official_description: Fuel Pump Primary Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Fuel pump electrical circuit problem.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel pump not getting power - engine may not start or may stall.

codes.official_description: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Flow Excessive Detected
codes.workshop_diagnosis: EGR system flowing too much exhaust gas.
codes.user_explanation: EGR valve stuck open - engine may run rough or stall at idle.

codes.official_description: Evaporative Emission Control System Incorrect Purge Flow
codes.workshop_diagnosis: EVAP purge system not flowing correctly.
codes.user_explanation: Fuel vapor purge system problem - emissions affected.

codes.official_description: Vehicle Speed Sensor Range/Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Vehicle speed sensor reading out of expected range.
codes.user_explanation: Speed sensor giving wrong readings - speedometer and systems affected.

codes.official_description: Internal Control Module Memory Check Sum Error
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ECM internal memory corruption detected.
codes.user_explanation: Engine computer memory problem - may need reprogramming or replacement.

codes.official_description: Transmission Control System Range/Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Transmission control system operating outside normal range.
codes.user_explanation: Transmission computer problem - shifting may be erratic.

codes.official_description: System Too Lean Bank 2
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Fuel mixture too lean on bank 2 cylinders.
codes.user_explanation: Bank 2 engine running lean - not enough fuel in mixture.

codes.official_description: System Too Rich Bank 2
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Fuel mixture too rich on bank 2 cylinders.
codes.user_explanation: Bank 2 engine running rich - too much fuel in mixture.

codes.official_description: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Bank 1 or Single Sensor
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Camshaft position sensor A circuit malfunction on bank 1. Check sensor, wiring, connections, and timing correlation with crankshaft sensor.
codes.user_explanation: Your camshaft position sensor has a problem that may prevent the engine from starting or cause poor performance.

codes.official_description: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1 or Single Sensor
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Camshaft position sensor A signal out of range or poor performance on bank 1. Check sensor correlation with crankshaft sensor and timing.
codes.user_explanation: Your camshaft position sensor is providing incorrect readings, which may affect engine timing and performance.

codes.official_description: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Low Bank 1 or Single Sensor
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Low voltage detected in camshaft position sensor A circuit on bank 1. Check for short to ground, damaged wiring, or sensor failure.
codes.user_explanation: Your camshaft position sensor has a low voltage problem that may affect engine timing and operation.

codes.official_description: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit High Bank 1 or Single Sensor
codes.workshop_diagnosis: High voltage detected in camshaft position sensor A circuit on bank 1. Check for short to power, damaged wiring, or sensor failure.
codes.user_explanation: Your camshaft position sensor has a high voltage problem that may affect engine timing and operation.

codes.official_description: Camshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Intermittent Bank 1 or Single Sensor
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Intermittent signal from camshaft position sensor A circuit on bank 1. Check for loose connections, vibration damage, or intermittent sensor failure.
codes.user_explanation: Your camshaft position sensor has an intermittent connection problem that may cause sporadic engine issues.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil Primary/Secondary Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil primary or secondary circuit. Check all ignition coils, wiring, and connections. May affect multiple cylinders.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with your ignition coil system that may cause misfires and poor engine performance.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil A Primary Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil A primary control circuit. Check coil A, wiring, and ignition control module connections.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with ignition coil A that may cause misfires in the associated cylinder.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil B Primary Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil B primary control circuit. Check coil B, wiring, and ignition control module connections.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with ignition coil B that may cause misfires in the associated cylinder.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil C Primary Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil C primary control circuit. Check coil C, wiring, and ignition control module connections.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with ignition coil C that may cause misfires in the associated cylinder.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil D Primary Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil D primary control circuit. Check coil D, wiring, and ignition control module connections.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with ignition coil D that may cause misfires in the associated cylinder.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil E Primary Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil E primary control circuit. Check coil E, wiring, and ignition control module connections.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with ignition coil E that may cause misfires in the associated cylinder.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil F Primary Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil F primary control circuit. Check coil F, wiring, and ignition control module connections.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with ignition coil F that may cause misfires in the associated cylinder.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil G Primary Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil G primary control circuit. Check coil G, wiring, and ignition control module connections.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with ignition coil G that may cause misfires in the associated cylinder.

codes.official_description: Ignition Coil H Primary Control Circuit/Open
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Open circuit in ignition coil H primary control circuit. Check coil H, wiring, and ignition control module connections.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with ignition coil H that may cause misfires in the associated cylinder.

codes.official_description: Transmission Control System Electrical
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Electrical fault in TCM circuit. Check TCM power supply, ground connections, and CAN bus communication. Verify wiring integrity.
codes.user_explanation: There's an electrical problem with the transmission control system. The transmission may not respond properly to your driving commands.

codes.official_description: Brake Switch B Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Secondary brake switch circuit malfunction. Check brake pedal switch B operation, wiring, and signal to TCM. Verify switch adjustment.
codes.user_explanation: The backup brake switch that tells the transmission when you're braking is not working properly. This can affect shifting.
common_causes: Wiring problems in brake switch circuit

codes.official_description: Clutch Switch Input Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Clutch pedal switch circuit fault. Check clutch switch operation, adjustment, and wiring. Verify signal reaches TCM properly.
codes.user_explanation: The switch that tells the car when you press the clutch pedal is not working correctly. This mainly affects manual transmissions.

codes.official_description: Transmission Range Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: PRNDL sensor signal out of expected range. Check sensor calibration, mechanical linkage, and electrical connections. Verify proper sensor operation.
codes.user_explanation: The gear selector position sensor is giving incorrect readings. Your transmission may not know which gear you've selected.

codes.official_description: Transmission Range Sensor A Circuit Low
codes.workshop_diagnosis: PRNDL sensor voltage below threshold. Check sensor power supply, ground circuit, and signal wire for shorts to ground. Test sensor resistance.
codes.user_explanation: The gear selector position sensor is getting too low voltage. This can cause the transmission to not recognize gear selections properly.

codes.official_description: Transmission Range Sensor A Circuit High
codes.workshop_diagnosis: PRNDL sensor voltage above threshold. Check for short to power in wiring, faulty sensor, or TCM input problems. Verify sensor power supply.
codes.user_explanation: The gear selector position sensor is getting too high voltage. This can prevent the transmission from recognizing which gear you've selected.
common_causes: Short to power in sensor wiring

codes.official_description: Transmission Range Sensor A Circuit Intermittent
codes.workshop_diagnosis: PRNDL sensor signal intermittent. Check for loose connections, damaged wiring, or faulty sensor. Monitor signal during gear selector movement.
codes.user_explanation: The gear selector position sensor signal keeps cutting in and out. This can cause unpredictable transmission behavior.

codes.official_description: TCS Control Channel A Valve 1
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Traction Control System control channel A valve 1 circuit malfunction. Check valve wiring, connector integrity, valve operation, and control module output signals.
codes.user_explanation: The traction control system valve is not working properly, which may affect vehicle stability on slippery surfaces.

codes.official_description: TCS Control Channel A Valve 2
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Traction Control System control channel A valve 2 circuit malfunction. Check valve wiring, connector integrity, valve operation, and control module output signals.
codes.user_explanation: The second traction control valve is not working properly, affecting the system's ability to control wheel spin.

codes.official_description: TCS Control Channel B Valve 1
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Traction Control System control channel B valve 1 circuit malfunction. Check valve wiring, connector integrity, valve operation, and control module output signals.
codes.user_explanation: The traction control system valve on channel B is not working properly, which may reduce traction control effectiveness.

codes.official_description: TCS Control Channel B Valve 2
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Traction Control System control channel B valve 2 circuit malfunction. Check valve wiring, connector integrity, valve operation, and control module output signals.

codes.official_description: Transmission Fluid Temperature Sensor A Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Transmission fluid temperature sensor circuit malfunction. Check sensor operation, wiring, and TCM input. Verify sensor resistance at different temperatures.
codes.user_explanation: The sensor that monitors transmission fluid temperature is not working properly. This can affect transmission shifting and protection.

codes.official_description: Transmission Fluid Temperature Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Temperature sensor reading out of expected range. Compare sensor reading with actual fluid temperature. Check sensor calibration and mounting.
codes.user_explanation: The transmission temperature sensor is giving readings that don't match the actual fluid temperature.

codes.official_description: Transmission Fluid Temperature Sensor A Circuit Low
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Temperature sensor voltage below threshold. Check sensor wiring for shorts to ground, sensor power supply, and sensor resistance. Test TCM input.
codes.user_explanation: The transmission temperature sensor is getting too low voltage, which can give false temperature readings.
common_causes: Short to ground in sensor wiring

codes.official_description: Transmission Fluid Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Temperature sensor voltage above threshold. Check for short to power in wiring, faulty sensor, or TCM problems. Verify sensor power supply voltage.
codes.user_explanation: The transmission temperature sensor is getting too high voltage, which can give false temperature readings.

codes.official_description: Transmission Fluid Temperature Sensor A Circuit Intermittent

codes.official_description: Input/Turbine Shaft Speed Sensor A Circuit No Signal

codes.official_description: Input/Turbine Shaft Speed Sensor A Circuit Intermittent

codes.official_description: Output Shaft Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance

codes.official_description: Output Shaft Speed Sensor Circuit No Signal

codes.official_description: Intake Air Flow Mass Too Low
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Mass air flow sensor reading below expected range, possible vacuum leak, dirty MAF sensor, or intake system restriction affecting engine performance.
codes.user_explanation: The engine's air intake system is not getting enough air flow, which can cause poor performance and increased fuel consumption.
common_causes: Dirty or faulty Mass Air Flow (MAF) sensor

codes.official_description: Intake Air Flow Mass Too High
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Mass air flow sensor reading above expected range, possible MAF sensor malfunction, intake air leak after sensor, or ECU calibration issue.
codes.user_explanation: The engine's air flow sensor is detecting more air than expected, which can cause rough running and poor fuel economy.
common_causes: Exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve stuck open

codes.official_description: Fuel System - High Pressure Relief Valve
codes.workshop_diagnosis: High pressure fuel system relief valve operation detected, possible over-pressurization, faulty fuel pump, or fuel pressure regulator malfunction.
codes.user_explanation: The fuel system pressure relief valve has activated, indicating a potential fuel pressure problem.

codes.official_description: ABS Control Module Vehicle Speed Signal
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ABS control module detecting inconsistent or invalid vehicle speed signal, possible wheel speed sensor fault, wiring issue, or control module malfunction.
codes.user_explanation: The ABS system is having trouble reading vehicle speed, which may affect braking performance and stability control.

codes.official_description: ABS Hydraulic Pump Motor Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ABS hydraulic pump motor electrical circuit fault, possible pump motor failure, wiring damage, or control module issue affecting brake assistance.
codes.user_explanation: The ABS hydraulic pump that assists with braking has an electrical problem, which may affect brake pedal feel and ABS operation.

codes.official_description: ABS Pump Motor Relay Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ABS pump motor relay circuit malfunction, possible relay failure, wiring fault, or control module issue preventing proper ABS pump operation.
codes.user_explanation: The relay controlling the ABS brake pump is not working properly, which can disable the ABS system.

codes.official_description: ABS Control Module Internal Fault
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ABS control module internal malfunction detected, possible control module failure, memory corruption, or internal component damage affecting ABS operation.
codes.user_explanation: The ABS control computer has detected an internal problem that may affect braking safety systems.

codes.official_description: ABS Motor Relay Circuit Malfunction
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ABS motor relay circuit fault, possible relay failure, wiring damage, or control module issue affecting ABS pump motor operation.
codes.user_explanation: The relay controlling the ABS brake pump motor has an electrical problem, which may affect brake assistance.

codes.official_description: ABS Motor Circuit Open/Short
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ABS motor circuit has open or short circuit condition, possible motor failure, wiring damage, or control module driver circuit fault.
codes.user_explanation: The ABS brake pump motor circuit has an electrical fault that may prevent proper brake assistance.

codes.official_description: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control 'A' Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Turbocharger boost control system performance issue, possible wastegate actuator fault, boost pressure sensor error, or vacuum leak affecting boost control.
codes.user_explanation: The turbocharger boost control system is not working properly, which may affect engine power and performance.

codes.official_description: Accelerator Pedal Position Sensor 'C' Circuit Range/Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Accelerator pedal position sensor C signal out of expected range, possible sensor drift, wiring issues, or pedal mechanism problems.
codes.user_explanation: The accelerator pedal position sensor is giving incorrect readings, which may affect throttle response and acceleration.

codes.official_description: Engine Coolant Pump Control Circuit Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Electric coolant pump control circuit performance issue - check pump motor, verify control signals, inspect wiring harness, test pump operation and flow rates.
codes.user_explanation: The electric coolant pump isn't working properly, which can cause engine overheating issues.

codes.official_description: ABS Hydraulic Unit Internal Valve Circuit
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ABS hydraulic unit internal valve circuit malfunction - check internal valve operation, verify hydraulic pressure, inspect valve solenoids, test circuit continuity.
codes.user_explanation: A valve inside the ABS brake system has an electrical problem, which may affect brake performance during emergency stops.

codes.official_description: Climate Control Module Communication Lost
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Climate control module communication lost - check CAN bus connections, verify module power supply, inspect wiring harness, test communication protocols.
codes.user_explanation: The air conditioning control module has lost communication with other systems, which may affect climate control functions.

codes.official_description: Chassis Control Module Communication Error
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Communication error between chassis control module and vehicle network. Check wiring harness, module connections, and CAN bus integrity. Common in Perodua/Toyota vehicles.
possible_causes: Power supply issues to chassis module
troubleshooting_steps: Inspect CAN bus wiring for damage
Test module power and ground circuits
Verify network communication with scan tool
Update or reprogram chassis control module if needed
safety_notes: Ensure vehicle is on level surface during diagnosis
Use proper scan tool for chassis system diagnosis
Follow manufacturer procedures for module replacement

codes.official_description: Cold Start Emission Reduction Strategy Incorrect Flow
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Cold start emission control system flow rate incorrect. This affects emission levels during engine warm-up phase. Common in modern Perodua and Toyota vehicles with advanced emission systems.
troubleshooting_steps: Check cold start emission valve operation
Verify ECM parameters and software version
Check emission control valve electrical circuits
safety_notes: Ensure engine is cold before testing
Follow environmental regulations for emission work

codes.official_description: Body Control Module Internal Communication Error
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Internal communication fault within body control module. May affect lighting, comfort features, or accessory functions. Common issue in Perodua vehicles with integrated body control systems.
troubleshooting_steps: Check BCM power and ground circuits
repair_procedures: Replace body control module if hardware fault
Test all body control functions after repair
safety_notes: Ensure proper module coding after installation
Test all safety-related functions after repair

codes.official_description: Engine Control Module Internal Temperature Sensor Performance
codes.workshop_diagnosis: ECM internal temperature sensor is reading outside normal range. This affects engine performance calculations and thermal management. Common in Toyota/Camry vehicles with aging ECMs.
codes.user_explanation: Your engine computer's internal temperature sensor is faulty, which can affect engine performance and fuel economy calculations.
troubleshooting_steps: Test ECM temperature readings with scan tool
Replace ECM if internal sensor failed

codes.official_description: Body Control Module Internal Diagnostic Error
codes.workshop_diagnosis: Body Control Module has detected an internal diagnostic error or communication fault. This may affect various body functions like lighting, door locks, or comfort features. Common in Toyota vehicles.
codes.user_explanation: Your car's body control computer has detected an internal error. This may affect lights, door locks, or other comfort features.
troubleshooting_steps: Check BCM fuses and power supply
Replace BCM if internal fault confirmed
